entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My shoes echoed on stone as I walke..."
entries.dialogueText: My shoes echoed on stone as I walked down the palace corridor to Hugo's study.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle had invited me for a one-o..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle had invited me for a one-on-one talk. And though I had plenty on my mind, I could hardly decline.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus remained on guard outside as..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus remained on guard outside as I pushed open the door and stepped inside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I cast my eye over the filigreed ma..."
entries.dialogueText: I cast my eye over the filigreed mahogany desk, the antique cabinets and the tasteful paintings and sculptures lining the walls.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A fire flickered in the fireplace...."
entries.dialogueText: A fire flickered in the fireplace. Two leather armchairs had been set out in front of it -- one empty, the other occupied by Hugo.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle rose and bowed upon my app..."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle rose and bowed upon my approach.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your Majesty. Thank you for joinin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. Thank you for joining me this evening."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come off it, Hugo. It's just us tw..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come off it, Hugo. It's just us two here. Talk to me as an equal."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course, Your Grace. When my Gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Grace. When my Grand Vizier summons me, I have no choice but to obey."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't have much time. What do yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't have much time. What do you want?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course the war deserves your fu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course the war deserves your full attention. I will make this brief."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course you have a lot on your p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course you have a lot on your plate. I will make this brief."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What's going on? Is there news abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's going on? Is there news about Vina?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He shook his head sorrowfully."
entries.dialogueText: He shook his head sorrowfully.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'm afraid not. We must trust that..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid not. We must trust that our brave men and women in uniform will bring her back home safely."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As you prefer, Romus.""
entries.dialogueText: "As you prefer, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Regardless, I know you have much b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless, I know you have much business to attend to. So I appreciate you taking the time to come here."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He beckoned me over, and we both sa..."
entries.dialogueText: He beckoned me over, and we both sat.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Tell me, my nephew...'"
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me, my nephew...'

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Tell me, Your Majesty...""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell me, Your Majesty..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""How much thought have you given to..."
entries.dialogueText: "How much thought have you given to the future of House Toras?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This family means everything to me..."
entries.dialogueText: "This family means everything to me. You should know that by now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's the future of this kingdom th..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the future of this kingdom that concerns me, not that of my house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A king's legacy should be determin..."
entries.dialogueText: "A king's legacy should be determined by his words and deeds, not his lineage."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What future? I aspire to make this..."
entries.dialogueText: "What future? I aspire to make this country a place where noble names no longer carry any weight."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I should. And yet...""
entries.dialogueText: "I should. And yet..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The two futures are one and the sa..."
entries.dialogueText: "The two futures are one and the same, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Our family's roots can be traced a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our family's roots can be traced all the way back to the Rezenid Empire. We have survived war, conquest and numerous challenges to the throne to be where we are today."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He folded his arms."
entries.dialogueText: He folded his arms.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Whatever your aspirations, you can..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever your aspirations, you cannot deny your heritage."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But how will his words and deeds l..."
entries.dialogueText: "But how will his words and deeds live on with no name to remember him by?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I brought you here to give you a w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I brought you here to give you a warning. Certain members of our house have begun to speak ill of you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He picked up a poker and jostled th..."
entries.dialogueText: He picked up a poker and jostled the logs in the fireplace. A shower of sparks flew upwards.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You'll be happy to know that House..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll be happy to know that House Toras is quite pleased with your reign so far."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Certain members'. Are you one of..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Certain members'. Are you one of them?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My decisions were made with my cou..."
entries.dialogueText: "My decisions were made with my country in mind. If that pisses off a few cousins, so be it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What do you mean? I've done nothin..."
entries.dialogueText: "What do you mean? I've done nothing but try to earn their favor since I took the throne."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno's nails clicked on stone as m..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno's nails clicked on stone as my dog followed me down the palace corridor to Hugo's study.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno raced into the room as I push..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno raced into the room as I pushed open the door. Titus remained on guard outside.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno was trying to jump up into my..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno was trying to jump up into my uncle's lap. Hugo sternly shooed the dog off and ordered him to lie at his feet.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll thank you to be nicer to Brun..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll thank you to be nicer to Bruno."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Dogs crave strict hierarchies, You..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dogs crave strict hierarchies, Your Majesty. They are happiest when they know who their master is."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He rose and bowed as I approached."
entries.dialogueText: He rose and bowed as I approached.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Surely they realize the extenuatin..."
entries.dialogueText: "Surely they realize the extenuating circumstances I'm facing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They'd better be. I've done nothin..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'd better be. I've done nothing but try to earn their favor since taking the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My decisions as king have been mad..."
entries.dialogueText: "My decisions as king have been made with my country in mind. If my cousins like them too, that's just a bonus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for telling me that. It..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for telling me that. It means a lot to know I have Valenqiris' support during these trying times."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then what's with the 'in danger of..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then what's with the 'in danger of losing it all' talk?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""'Extenuating circumstances' do not..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Extenuating circumstances' do not explain all of your policies."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You've exploited our beloved Valen..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've exploited our beloved Valenqiris for resources while failing to mitigate the environmental damage that resulted."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Just as I warned, there has been a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Just as I warned, there has been a sizeable backlash against the anti-landowner tax you introduced."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your permissive attitude towards f..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your permissive attitude towards foreigners has left native Rizians questioning their place in the new order."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I personally am worried about the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I personally am worried about the steps you have taken to erode this country's Wruhecist foundations. And I am not the only one."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The less said about your permissiv..."
entries.dialogueText: "The less said about your permissive attitude towards sexual deviancy, the better."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I beg your pardon, but you cannot..."
entries.dialogueText: "I beg your pardon, but you cannot be serious about that."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Our relations are unfortunately mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our relations are unfortunately more than merely 'pissed off''."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I myself would never say a word ag..."
entries.dialogueText: "I myself would never say a word against you. But some of your decisions have admittedly vexed me."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your attempts have paid off.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your attempts have paid off."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm not going to apologize for any..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not going to apologize for anything."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Watch your mouth, Uncle. Your stat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Watch your mouth, Uncle. Your statements are bordering on treasonous."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I had no idea I had angered our ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "I had no idea I had angered our house that much. Thank you for telling me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't even think about appeasing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't even think about appeasing House Toras until we get Vina back."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I can't even think about appeasing..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't even think about appeasing House Toras until we win the war."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am not telling you this because..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am not telling you this because I want an apology. My aim is to keep you in power."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I wouldn't be a very effective adv..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't be a very effective advisor if I didn't tell you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Treason is the last thing on my mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Treason is the last thing on my mind. I am trying to keep you in power."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I would advise a different approac..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would advise a different approach. If our house does not support you within Rizia, they will not support the rescue of your daughter."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I would advise a different approac..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would advise a different approach. If our house does not support you within Rizia, they will not support you on the battlefield."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If our house does not support you..."
entries.dialogueText: "If our house does not support you within Rizia, they will not support you on the battlefield."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am loath to remind you, but ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am loath to remind you, but there are those in House Toras who believe my brother, and hence you, should have been removed from the royal line of succession after introducing commoner blood."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your actions as king have unfortun..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your actions as king have unfortunately poured fuel on those flames."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Then what do you suggest I do? I c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then what do you suggest I do? I can't backtrack on my decisions."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And, well...""
entries.dialogueText: "And, well..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They're a bunch of crackpots. Nobo..."
entries.dialogueText: "They're a bunch of crackpots. Nobody will listen to them."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia has other royal houses. It's..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia has other royal houses. It's fine if I lose the support of one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What exactly are you implying? Are..."
entries.dialogueText: "What exactly are you implying? Are you calling my legitimacy as king into question?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course I respect your legitimac..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I respect your legitimacy, Your Majesty. I am simply repeating the claims of others."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Some of those 'crackpots' wield ex..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some of those 'crackpots' wield extraordinary influence in Valenqiris and Rizia Imperii."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But you can make wiser ones in the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you can make wiser ones in the future."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""To lose House Toras is to lose Val..."
entries.dialogueText: "To lose House Toras is to lose Valenqiris and Rizia Imperii. In other words, half of our kingdom's population."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Manus Sazon.""
entries.dialogueText: "Manus Sazon."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But I will tell you this. If you p..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I will tell you this. If you permit Her Highness to marry this man, your grip on the throne will weaken to the point where I cannot recover it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""They are in love. I can't deny the..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are in love. I can't deny them that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He'll give up his name if he marri..."
entries.dialogueText: "He'll give up his name if he marries her. Their children will still be Torases."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's not just the Sazon heir, he's..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's not just the Sazon heir, he's the House of Delegates majority speaker. He could be a powerful ally."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He's not just the Sazon heir, he's..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's not just the Sazon heir, he's the House of Delegates opposition leader. Marrying him to Vina will help neutralize him."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You truly are your father's son.""
entries.dialogueText: "You truly are your father's son."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""At the expense of Rizian tradition.""
entries.dialogueText: "At the expense of Rizian tradition."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Or a powerful enemy.""
entries.dialogueText: "Or a powerful enemy."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Or turn him into even more of a da..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or turn him into even more of a danger."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You needn't allow your reign to be..."
entries.dialogueText: "You needn't allow your reign to be undone by a pair of starry-eyed youths. There are actions that can be taken."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am certain you had good intentio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am certain you had good intentions in allowing the Sazon heir to court Vina."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let the chips fall where they may...."
entries.dialogueText: "Let the chips fall where they may. I am not going to interfere in my daughter's love life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""'Actions'. That sounds like a euph..."
entries.dialogueText: "'Actions'. That sounds like a euphemism if I ever heard one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've been good to his house. Perha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've been good to his house. Perhaps I can convince him to back off."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It won't be easy, but I can try to..."
entries.dialogueText: "It won't be easy, but I can try to convince him to back off."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo nodded."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo nodded.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As king, you can make use of the G..."
entries.dialogueText: "As king, you can make use of the Golden Guard's expanded powers to implicate the boy in treason."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As a first step, yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "As a first step, yes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo replied without a trace of ang..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo replied without a trace of anger in his voice.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""By all means, then, allow the Sazo..."
entries.dialogueText: "By all means, then, allow the Sazon union to proceed."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""With Su Omina still on your side,..."
entries.dialogueText: "With Su Omina still on your side, it would not be difficult to arrange a covert assassination."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I could never do that to Vina.""
entries.dialogueText: "No. I could never do that to Vina."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What makes you think I'd even cons..."
entries.dialogueText: "What makes you think I'd even consider such a suggestion?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But if that doesn't work, you have..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if that doesn't work, you have other channels available to you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Once Vina makes it safely home fro..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once Vina makes it safely home from Pales, that is."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Tempting. What am I even king for,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tempting. What am I even king for, if not to get rid of my rivals?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He's an intelligent young man. Sur..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's an intelligent young man. Surely he can be persuaded to do right by this kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I see no need for action. Manus is..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see no need for action. Manus isn't a threat to me."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'll do my best to spin it as a po..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll do my best to spin it as a positive for our house. But I cannot promise I will succeed."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If that is your decision, I will r..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that is your decision, I will respect it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But if you're going to allow Mr. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if you're going to allow Mr. Sazon to lurk in the background, it's even more imperative that Her Highness be wed as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""She's still young, you know.""
entries.dialogueText: "She's still young, you know."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Apologies if I misunderstood, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apologies if I misunderstood, Your Majesty. I thought you expanded the Golden Guard with exactly this kind of eventuality in mind."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Apologies if I misunderstood, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Apologies if I misunderstood, Your Majesty. I thought you supported Su Omina with just this kind of eventuality in mind."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I have not even mentioned our hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have not even mentioned our house's gravest concern."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He spoke the name like a curse word..."
entries.dialogueText: He spoke the name like a curse word.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Not only does the young radical no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not only does the young radical now lead the House of Delegates..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'm worried that he may still harb..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm worried that he may still harbor intentions to wed your daughter."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I'm worried that he may have desig..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm worried that he may have designs on your daughter."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The young radical's influence in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "The young radical's influence in the House of Delegates may have diminished, but I wouldn't underestimate his ability to sway people to his side."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Your daughter, for instance.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your daughter, for instance."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The young radical continues to put..."
entries.dialogueText: "The young radical continues to put forth preposterous proposals in the House Of Delegates. And furthermore..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't be ridiculous, Hugo. I would..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't be ridiculous, Hugo. I wouldn't let Vina anywhere near him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""As a matter of fact, he and Vina a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As a matter of fact, he and Vina asked for my blessing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""My daughter, the *war hostage*?""
entries.dialogueText: "My daughter, the *war hostage*?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Dammit, Hugo, don't you have anyth..."
entries.dialogueText: "Dammit, Hugo, don't you have anything better to do than worry about my daughter's love life?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo frowned sternly."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo frowned sternly.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We have already established that w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have already established that whom the Princess marries affects us all."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Even more so now that you have jeo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even more so now that you have jeopardized your relationship with House Toras."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I will assume you did not grant it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will assume you did not grant it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo looked at me in astonishment."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo looked at me in astonishment.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am confident she will soon be re..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am confident she will soon be returned from Pales safe and sound."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""When she does come back, who she m..."
entries.dialogueText: "When she does come back, who she marries will be of the utmost importance."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With a heavy heart, I denied their..."
entries.dialogueText: "With a heavy heart, I denied their love."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I told them I'd give them my bless..."
entries.dialogueText: "I told them I'd give them my blessing once Vina returned from Pales. I was hoping to buy some time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Forbid a young couple like that fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forbid a young couple like that from seeing each other, and it'll just drive them closer together."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are supposed to be my advisor,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are supposed to be my advisor, Uncle. Not my interlocutor."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It was the right decision.""
entries.dialogueText: "It was the right decision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Of course I didn't. I'm not an idi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course I didn't. I'm not an idiot."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I knew you weren't.""
entries.dialogueText: "I knew you weren't."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That isn't entirely within your co..."
entries.dialogueText: "That isn't entirely within your control, though, is it?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You're right. I should speak to yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. I should speak to you as an adult."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He's an ambitious young man. There..."
entries.dialogueText: "He's an ambitious young man. There must be something he wants more than the Princess."

entries.dialogueText: "Why do you think I sent her to Pales? It's been so long that she probably doesn't even think about him anymore."

entries.dialogueText: "But can you be sure?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Still, if you want to completely make sure he will not be a problem... there are actions that can be taken."

entries.dialogueText: "Think of Lyza the Great's single folly. Do not underestimate the allure of forbidden love."

entries.dialogueText: "If you want to completely eliminate him as a threat... there are actions that can be taken."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "But if you're going to allow Mr. Sazon to lurk in the background, it's even more imperative that Her Highness be wed immediately after her return from Pales."

entries.dialogueText: "All I am saying is that if you want to completely eliminate Mr. Sazon as a threat, there are actions that can be taken."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The last time you tried getting th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The last time you tried getting those two together, Bruno got shot."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You saw what happened on our hunti..."
entries.dialogueText: "You saw what happened on our hunting trip. They don't get along at all."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A political marriage is not about..."
entries.dialogueText: "A political marriage is not about 'getting along'. You of all people should know that."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A political marriage is not about..."
entries.dialogueText: "A political marriage is not about 'getting along'. Just ask Rita, if you can drag her out of the casinos."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Will it get House Toras back on my..."
entries.dialogueText: "Will it get House Toras back on my side, even after everything I did?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It was indeed rather disastrous. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was indeed rather disastrous. But not through any fault of theirs."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""After the mess Rico's made of Iza,..."
entries.dialogueText: "After the mess Rico's made of Iza, you still want Vina to marry him?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""They'll forgive any number of tran..."
entries.dialogueText: "They'll forgive any number of transgressions if they know a Toras heir is forthcoming."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He had Iza under control. Your dec..."
entries.dialogueText: "He had Iza under control. Your decision to hand Duchess Azaro command of the police unit there complicated the situation."

entries.title: Narrator: "He lowered his voice."
entries.dialogueText: He lowered his voice.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Like the extrajudicial capabilitie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like the extrajudicial capabilities of the Golden Guard."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Like the extralegal talents of Su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Like the extralegal talents of Su Omina."

entries.dialogueText: "I would only suggest such a thing in extreme circumstances. Of which, I would argue, this is one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Sounds ghastly. But if there's no other way out of this..."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Excellent advice. See, this is wha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent advice. See, this is what I keep you around for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It means a lot to know you're on m..."
entries.dialogueText: "It means a lot to know you're on my side, even if the rest of our house is not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want you to 'spin' anythin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want you to 'spin' anything. Our relatives will accept this pairing even if I have to cram it down their throats."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am confident that you will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am confident that you will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for trying anyway.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for trying anyway."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He peered at me sternly.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "I think you know what I'm referring to. Or more accurately, whom."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Consider that bonus earned."

entries.dialogueText: "I would not be saying this if it weren't true."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "The RNC's reclamation of seats in the House of Delegates was an extremely positive development."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Your favorable tax policies have helped Valenqiris landowners flourish, even in the face of uncertainty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "The traditionalists in our family were very satisfied with your further enshrinement of Wruhecism in Rizian law."

entries.dialogueText: "Of course, the investment you have made in our home province has been greatly appreciated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What kind of king would I be if I..."
entries.dialogueText: "What kind of king would I be if I couldn't keep my own family happy?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What does the favor of House Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "What does the favor of House Toras matter when my daughter is being held prisoner?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What does the favor of House Toras..."
entries.dialogueText: "What does the favor of House Toras matter when we're at war?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Our house is throwing its full sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our house is throwing its full support behind the rescue of your daughter. Had you betrayed Toras values, that might not be the case."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Our house is ready and willing to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our house is ready and willing to support Rizia on the battlefield. Had you betrayed Toras values, that might not be the case."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Indeed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Is that why you summoned me here?..."
entries.dialogueText: "Is that why you summoned me here? To tell me what a good job I've done?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Unfortunately not.""
entries.dialogueText: "Unfortunately not."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Even if I hadn't done all that, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even if I hadn't done all that, they'd have to like me. I'm the king and the house heir."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am loath to remind you, but ther..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am loath to remind you, but there are those in House Toras who believe my brother, and hence you, should have been removed from the royal line of succession after introducing commoner blood."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Fortunately, they have not spoken..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fortunately, they have not spoken out since you took the throne."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But there is something that could..."
entries.dialogueText: "But there is something that could cause you to lose our house entirely. Or rather -- someone."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And the last thing you want to do..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the last thing you want to do is lose the popularity you've gained with House Toras."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Forgive me. But as you know, whom..."
entries.dialogueText: "Forgive me. But as you know, whom the Princess weds affects us all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't need House Toras' favor th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't need House Toras' favor that badly."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's not about our favor. It's abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not about our favor. It's about our legacy."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Absolutely not. No king should be..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely not. No king should be above the law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I might well go that route in anot..."
entries.dialogueText: "I might well go that route in another situation. But not to get rid of Manus Sazon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I admit I'm not comfortable with t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I admit I'm not comfortable with the extra-legal aspect of it all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Hugo. How could you be so cold?""
entries.dialogueText: "Hugo. How could you be so cold?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A log in the fireplace snapped, sta..."
entries.dialogueText: A log in the fireplace snapped, startling both of us.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Cold?""
entries.dialogueText: "Cold?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You cannot fathom the depths of my..."
entries.dialogueText: "You cannot fathom the depths of my love for this family."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Even during the nadir of your fath..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even during the nadir of your father's popularity, when the populace was clamoring for me to seize the throne... I stood by my brother's side."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am here to serve, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am here to serve, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""On the contrary. A sovereign, by v..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the contrary. A sovereign, by virtue of his absolute authority and divine right, is the source from which all laws flow, not subject to them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A sovereign, by virtue of his abso..."
entries.dialogueText: "A sovereign, by virtue of his absolute authority and divine right, is the source from which all laws flow, not subject to them."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Very well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I will leave it up to you. Perhaps..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will leave it up to you. Perhaps a good talking-to could scare him off just as easily."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I like carrots. They're full of vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like carrots. They're full of vitamins."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If talking to him doesn't work, ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "If talking to him doesn't work, can I just, you know, dispose of him?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course. I was hesitant to bring..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course. I was hesitant to bring up that option because I thought you were fond of him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd rather go straight for the sti..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd rather go straight for the stick. King Romus bends over backwards for nobody."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""By all means, make him an offer.""
entries.dialogueText: "By all means, make him an offer."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""By all means.""
entries.dialogueText: "By all means."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Perhaps with an expanded Golden Gu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps with an expanded Golden Guard... but it's too late now. I suggest you give him a good talking-to."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""However, this doesn't solve the pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, this doesn't solve the problem of whom the Princess should wed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll hazard a guess. You think the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll hazard a guess. You think the lucky groom should be Rico."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno's ears perked up at the menti..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno's ears perked up at the mention of his former master's name.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""There is a reason my son has not y..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a reason my son has not yet married, yes."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A royal union between two Torases..."
entries.dialogueText: "A royal union between two Torases will secure the future of our house beyond a shadow of a doubt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It'll also produce a child with ho..."
entries.dialogueText: "It'll also produce a child with hooves."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That's a myth. Need I remind you t..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a myth. Need I remind you that I myself was the product of an inter-house marriage?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have half a mind to marry her to..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have half a mind to marry her to Axel Reinhart."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo drew his breath in through his..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo drew his breath in through his teeth.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want her to marry Manus. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want her to marry Manus. That doesn't mean I'm going to force her into a marriage with someone else."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've got enough to worry about...."
entries.dialogueText: "You've got enough to worry about. Trust me, I will handle this."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Risky. Very risky.""
entries.dialogueText: "Risky. Very risky."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I never said you should force her...."
entries.dialogueText: "I never said you should force her. That would be horrific."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But you can convince her to enter..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you can convince her to enter a political union for the good of the country. As your father convinced you."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Of course, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We came dangerously close to war w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We came dangerously close to war with Pales. I would not trust the Duke with your daughter just yet."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I know you are pursuing peace with..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you are pursuing peace with Pales. But I am still not convinced Duke Reinhart shares your agenda."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I trust him. He has treated her we..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust him. He has treated her well the entire time she has been over there."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He had Iza under control. Your wit..."
entries.dialogueText: "He had Iza under control. Your withdrawal of the police unit you'd transferred there complicated the situation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I will always support you, my neph..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will always support you, my nephew. Do not doubt my loyalty."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I recall my mother saying somethin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I recall my mother saying something similar. Almost verbatim, in fact."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We shall see.""
entries.dialogueText: "We shall see."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It's what I am here for.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's what I am here for."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He has Iza under control. You'll s..."
entries.dialogueText: "He has Iza under control. You'll see."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""He did the best he could given his..."
entries.dialogueText: "He did the best he could given his lack of support from the Crown."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo laughed."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo laughed.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I do not want to worry you. But at..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not want to worry you. But at this point, pairing Vina and Rico may be the only way to prevent key members of our house from switching allegiances."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""This would be the ultimate show of..."
entries.dialogueText: "This would be the ultimate show of loyalty to House Toras. I can't think of anything that would make our relations more grateful."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Short of producing a male heir you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Short of producing a male heir yourself."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused in thoughtful reflection."
entries.dialogueText: He paused in thoughtful reflection.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Think about it. It's the ultimate..."
entries.dialogueText: "Think about it. It's the ultimate gesture of Rizian-Palesian unification."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Reinhart's a nice guy. Now that we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reinhart's a nice guy. Now that we've gotten over our misunderstandings."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't you see? Having Reinhart as..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't you see? Having Reinhart as a son-in-law is the only surefire way to get him under my thumb."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Or yet another opportunity for a P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or yet another opportunity for a Palesian power grab."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Give him what he wants, and see if..."
entries.dialogueText: "Give him what he wants, and see if he remains 'nice'."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Until you die, and the Reinharts t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Until you die, and the Reinharts take the Rizian throne."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Because he knew he would face Rizi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Because he knew he would face Rizian retaliation if he did not."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I do not want to worry you. But na..."
entries.dialogueText: "I do not want to worry you. But name the wrong man as Prince Consort, and we may no longer be able to prevent key members of our house from switching allegiances."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As I said, you have earned House T..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I said, you have earned House Toras' loyalty. But name the wrong man as Prince Consort, and you run the risk of losing it."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused."
entries.dialogueText: He paused.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Well, unless you can produce a mal..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, unless you can produce a male heir yourself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I suppose she can always see other..."
entries.dialogueText: "I suppose she can always see other people on the side..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As long as the so-called free pres..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as the so-called free press never finds out about it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As long as you continue to keep a..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as you continue to keep a lid on the press."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I made a promise to her. I'd be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I made a promise to her. I'd be a bad father if I didn't keep it."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It was rash of you to make that pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was rash of you to make that promise in the first place."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""For the good of the country? Or fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "For the good of the country? Or for our own house's gain?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I always hated him for that. I don..."
entries.dialogueText: "I always hated him for that. I don't want Vina feeling that way about me."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The most profound acts of love for..."
entries.dialogueText: "The most profound acts of love for one's family often go unreciprocated."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Father did know better than I knew..."
entries.dialogueText: "Father did know better than I knew myself at the time."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We hold the throne. What is good f..."
entries.dialogueText: "We hold the throne. What is good for us is good for the entire kingdom."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Fathers usually do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Fathers usually do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Until his dying breath.""
entries.dialogueText: "Until his dying breath."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You would have made a lousy king,..."
entries.dialogueText: "You would have made a lousy king, anyway."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That isn't love. It's cowardice.""
entries.dialogueText: "That isn't love. It's cowardice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know. I apologize. Thank you for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know. I apologize. Thank you for your loyalty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded in acknowledgement."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded in acknowledgement.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He gritted his teeth."
entries.dialogueText: He gritted his teeth.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We are veering off course.""
entries.dialogueText: "We are veering off course."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw pain in his eyes."
entries.dialogueText: I saw pain in his eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Yes.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Regarding the Sazon situation, I w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regarding the Sazon situation, I will leave it up to you. Perhaps a good talking-to would be just as effective."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I shouldn't be harping on about th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shouldn't be harping on about this with the Princess facing such an uncertain fate. The war deserves your full attention."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I should stop harping on about thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should stop harping on about this. The war deserves your full attention."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I should stop harping on about thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I should stop harping on about this. I know you and the Princess will make the right decision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Indeed it does. I should be going..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed it does. I should be going now."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, thank you for bringing this up..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, thank you for bringing this up. You've given me a lot to think about."

entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry to harp on about this with the Princess facing such an uncertain fate. The war deserves your full attention."

entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I am sorry to harp on about this...."
entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry to harp on about this. The war deserves your full attention."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "I am sorry to harp on about this when your mind has clearly been made up."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, please stop harping. I know the tune by heart already."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You're my Grand Vizier and my uncle. Your advice is always valuable to me."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: We rose from our chairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Bruno sat up and licked Hugo's hand..."
entries.dialogueText: Bruno sat up and licked Hugo's hand hopefully. My uncle gave the dog a single pat on the head.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""See that you don't spoil him.""
entries.dialogueText: "See that you don't spoil him."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""He is the King's dog. Why shouldn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "He is the King's dog. Why shouldn't he be treated like royalty?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I won't.""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I shot his leg off. He gets whatev..."
entries.dialogueText: "I shot his leg off. He gets whatever he wants."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The fire began to flicker out as Hu..."
entries.dialogueText: The fire began to flicker out as Hugo ushered me out the door.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus shadowed me down the hall as..."
entries.dialogueText: Titus shadowed me down the hall as I made my way back towards my quarters.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the way there, we passed my stud..."
entries.dialogueText: On the way there, we passed my study door.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I picked up the phone."
entries.dialogueText: I picked up the phone.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "After instructing Titus to wait out..."
entries.dialogueText: After instructing Titus to wait outside, I entered the study and picked up the phone.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Come in for a second, Titus. I wan..."
entries.dialogueText: "Come in for a second, Titus. I want to speak to you privately."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I asked the palace operator to give..."
entries.dialogueText: I asked the palace operator to give me a private line to Manus Sazon. After a few rings, he answered.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""{RiziaDLCText.ManusToPlayer}. To w..."
entries.dialogueText: "{RiziaDLCText.ManusToPlayer}. To what do I owe this pleasure?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "We kept walking until we reached my..."
entries.dialogueText: We kept walking until we reached my quarters.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What would it take for you to go o..."
entries.dialogueText: "What would it take for you to go on a permanent vacation?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The time has come for you to do yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The time has come for you to do your patriotic duty. I am sending you to lead your province's battalion in Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I asked the palace operator to give..."
entries.dialogueText: I asked the palace operator to give me a private line to Rico Toras. After a few rings, my cousin picked up.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Your Majesty. It's been a while.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. It's been a while."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Your Majesty. How is Bruno?""
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty. How is Bruno?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""What business is it of yours? You..."
entries.dialogueText: "What business is it of yours? You gave him away."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Would you like to talk to him?""
entries.dialogueText: "Would you like to talk to him?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your father thinks he's being spoi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your father thinks he's being spoiled."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""No, that's ridiculous. But give hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, that's ridiculous. But give him greetings from Bella."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""You're right, Your Majesty. Sorry..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right, Your Majesty. Sorry I asked."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Ha. He's a stone-cold killer. No a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ha. He's a stone-cold killer. No amount of pampering will soften him."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Anyway. Is there something I can d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Anyway. Is there something I can do for you?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Is there something I can do for you?"

entries.dialogueText: The line was quiet for a moment.

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I'm not sure what you're getting a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure what you're getting at."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I just had an uncomfortable talk with my uncle. My house is pressuring me to dispose of you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Such as ordering him to fight in P..."
entries.dialogueText: "Such as ordering him to fight in Pales?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""A most elegant solution. I doubt h..."
entries.dialogueText: "A most elegant solution. I doubt he's much of a fighter, but his charisma will work wonders on the Brenas troops."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If he doesn't make it back alive,..."
entries.dialogueText: "If he doesn't make it back alive, Vina will never forgive me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And if he comes back a war hero?""
entries.dialogueText: "And if he comes back a war hero?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If anyone can rescue Vina, he can.""
entries.dialogueText: "If anyone can rescue Vina, he can."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Love is an extremely potent motiva..."
entries.dialogueText: "Love is an extremely potent motivator."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""By then, ideally, the Princess wil..."
entries.dialogueText: "By then, ideally, the Princess will have been claimed by another suitor."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""His Rizian charisma... his charizz..."
entries.dialogueText: "His Rizian charisma... his charizzma, if you will. Or should we just call it 'rizz'?"

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""We should not.""
entries.dialogueText: "We should not."

entries.dialogueText: The line was quiet for a moment.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I... don't know what to say.""
entries.dialogueText: "I... don't know what to say."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I am honored, of course. But I hav..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am honored, of course. But I have no military training."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've seen what an inspiring leader..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've seen what an inspiring leader you can be. Your province's troops need you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're the only one I trust to res..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're the only one I trust to rescue my daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""With today's technology, you don't..."
entries.dialogueText: "With today's technology, you don't need training. You just need to be able to push buttons."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've displayed admirable strateg..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've displayed admirable strategic skills. Both in the House of Delegates, and in courting my daughter."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That's very kind of you. However...""
entries.dialogueText: "That's very kind of you. However..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I must warn you that if I leave th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must warn you that if I leave the House of Delegates, it will jeopardize our chances of reform."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Be that as it may...""
entries.dialogueText: "Be that as it may..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I feel I can aid our cause much mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I feel I can aid our cause much more capably in Porte Drazon than on the battlefield."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You claim to speak for the people...."
entries.dialogueText: "You claim to speak for the people. But how will it look if you let your province send commoners to die while refusing to go to war yourself?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are going to Pales, Mr. Sazon...."
entries.dialogueText: "You are going to Pales, Mr. Sazon. That's a royal order."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I am worried sick about Her Highne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am worried sick about Her Highness as well. And yet..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. If you'd rather leave V..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. If you'd rather leave Vina to rot in a dungeon, you don't have to go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. If you insist on betray..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. If you insist on betraying your country as your father did before you, you don't have to go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perhaps you have a point. Stay, th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perhaps you have a point. Stay, then. But I expect you to make yourself indispensable to me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He let out a long exhale."
entries.dialogueText: He let out a long exhale.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You are right, {RiziaDLCText.Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are right, {RiziaDLCText.ManusToPlayer}. I should not presume myself to be above this country's conscription laws."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a slight tremor in his vo..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a slight tremor in his voice as he replied.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I will do as you ask, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will do as you ask, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And I will do everything I can to..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I will do everything I can to bring the Princess home safe and sound."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He let out a long exhale."
entries.dialogueText: He let out a long exhale.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I would not dare to disobey my kin..."
entries.dialogueText: "I would not dare to disobey my king. I will go to Pales."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He let out a long exhale."
entries.dialogueText: He let out a long exhale.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Most certainly. I and the RPP will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most certainly. I and the RPP will not fail you during this time of crisis."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And I will do everything I can to..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I will do everything I can to lead Rizia to victory."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I have one suggestion. My absence..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have one suggestion. My absence will leave a power vacuum in House Sazon."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If you want to keep working with u..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you want to keep working with us, I recommend you end the exile of my mother. Bring her back to Rizia."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Never. She'll die on that island.""
entries.dialogueText: "Never. She'll die on that island."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""There are people out there who wan..."
entries.dialogueText: "There are people out there who want you killed. It's dangerous for you to stay in the country."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We were just starting to build mom..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were just starting to build momentum after our election gains. Removing me as majority leader could set us back years."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Who cares about reforms when we ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who cares about reforms when we have a war to win?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The RPP is already losing Delegate..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RPP is already losing Delegate seats. Removing me as opposition leader could shrink our numbers beyond recovery."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We must not overlook our country's..."
entries.dialogueText: "We must not overlook our country's internal welfare, even during times of war. Otherwise, what are our soldiers even fighting for?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Reforms are no less important duri..."
entries.dialogueText: "Reforms are no less important during wartime. In fact, they're especially crucial."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You have to ask yourself, {RiziaDL..."
entries.dialogueText: "You have to ask yourself, {RiziaDLCText.ManusToPlayer}. What kind of country are we fighting for?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""One battle at a time, Mr. Sazon. W..."
entries.dialogueText: "One battle at a time, Mr. Sazon. When you return victorious from Pales, we will turn back to our reforms."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I am fighting to restore our kingd..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am fighting to restore our kingdom's former borders. And so are you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I understand what you're saying. S..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand what you're saying. Stay in the capital, then, and keep your nose to the grindstone."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He exhaled slowly."
entries.dialogueText: He exhaled slowly.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand. I will do as you com..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I will do as you command."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I changed my mind about you and Vi..."
entries.dialogueText: "I changed my mind about you and Vina. I want the two of you as far away from each other as possible."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You and Vina shouldn't be around e..."
entries.dialogueText: "You and Vina shouldn't be around each other. Too much temptation."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You've got friends in Kyrute, righ..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've got friends in Kyrute, right? What if you were to just go back there?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I appreciate your concern for my s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I appreciate your concern for my safety."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But I've had a target on my back s..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I've had a target on my back since the day I was born. I found it's best not to live in fear."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I'm sorry? You made your approval..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry? You made your approval quite clear on the Rizania."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Read the writing on the wall, son...."
entries.dialogueText: "Read the writing on the wall, son. Rizia has no use for you anymore. You need to get out while you still can."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You made your feelings about us qu..."
entries.dialogueText: "You made your feelings about us quite clear on the Rizania. We would never disrespect your wishes."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I can't do that. My duty is to my..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't do that. My duty is to my house, my party and my country."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I can't do that. Not now that my p..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't do that. Not now that my party has finally gained a majority in the House of Delegates."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If you do, your combat fatigues aw..."
entries.dialogueText: "If you do, your combat fatigues await."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good. I am counting on you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good. I am counting on you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I still don't want you anywhere ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "I still don't want you anywhere near Vina."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Never.""
entries.dialogueText: "Never."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Understood.""

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes, you made yourself quite clear..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, you made yourself quite clear about that."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I put down the receiver and looked..."
entries.dialogueText: I put down the receiver and looked at the phone.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Angelica has more than served her..."
entries.dialogueText: "Angelica has more than served her sentence. Perhaps it's indeed time to bring her home."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""She's a disgraced noble, not a pol..."
entries.dialogueText: "She's a disgraced noble, not a politician."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Her legacy looms large in Brenas...."
entries.dialogueText: "Her legacy looms large in Brenas. If any Sazon can command a larger following than I can..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's been almost 30 years. She has..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been almost 30 years. She has had plenty of time to regret her role in the uprising."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's been almost 30 years. She has..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's been almost 30 years. She has spent more of her life on Caleqabiz than in her home province."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But it is your decision.""
entries.dialogueText: "But it is your decision."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Say farewell to Vina tonight. I wa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Say farewell to Vina tonight. I want you in Pales as soon as possible."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Enough talk. You'd better start pa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Enough talk. You'd better start packing."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Whatever happens, I know you will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Whatever happens, I know you will make your province proud."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wish you strength and luck on yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish you strength and luck on your perilous mission."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""And I wish you the same in steerin..."
entries.dialogueText: "And I wish you the same in steering the country through this tough time."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Thank you.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Oh-- of course. We will speak upon..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh-- of course. We will speak upon my return, {RiziaDLCText.ManusToPlayer}."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You must have read the rumors abou..."
entries.dialogueText: "You must have read the rumors about her and Axel Reinhart. Who knows what she got up to over there?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'll put it this way. If you agree..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll put it this way. If you agree to leave Rizia and break off all contact with Vina, I will make it worth your while."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a sharp intake of breath."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a sharp intake of breath.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I heard a sharp intake of breath."
entries.dialogueText: I heard a sharp intake of breath.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Worth my while?""
entries.dialogueText: "Worth my while?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, if you really think..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, if you really think there is anything in this world that's more valuable to me than Vina, I..."

entries.dialogueText: "The Sazon heir is a danger to our house. I need him gone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You know how you weren't involved..."
entries.dialogueText: "You know how you weren't involved in the Zille bombing? I want you to be 'uninvolved' in the disappearance of Manus Sazon."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I changed my mind. They're already..."
entries.dialogueText: "I changed my mind. They're already doing enough."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Sorry, the idiot operator connected me to you accidentally."

entries.dialogueText: "You're a politician. You know that sometimes, we have to sacrifice our individual desires on the altar of the greater good."

entries.dialogueText: "If we agree on this, I don't just want you to leave. I want you to break Vina's heart."

entries.dialogueText: "And her own leanings? Is she as radical as you are?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your love for your mother is touch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your love for your mother is touching. How about this, then: you leave Rizia, and I'll leave her alive."

entries.dialogueText: "Do you take me for a fool? That's like releasing a tarantula to take care of a gnat problem."

entries.dialogueText: "It's the only practical choice, to be honest."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: There was a long silence.

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty... you wouldn't execute the matriarch of the Sazon family without reason. Especially while we're at war."

entries.dialogueText: "For a chance to bring my mother back home... I will."

entries.dialogueText: I heard a sharp intake of breath.

entries.dialogueText: A long moment passed in silence.

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""So you love your mother more than..."
entries.dialogueText: "So you love your mother more than my daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "This was your plan all along, wasn't it? Springing your mother from prison?"

entries.dialogueText: "Vina's still young. She'll love again."

entries.dialogueText: "But if this is my only chance to end my mother's exile... I have to take it."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Not at all. I thought she was doomed to waste away on Caleqabiz."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "If this is my only chance to end her exile... I have to take it."

entries.dialogueText: "It's a deal, then. You will leave Rizia, and Angelica Sazon will return."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Never mind any of this. Freeing your mother is too high a price to pay."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If that's the way it must be. Just..."
entries.dialogueText: "If that's the way it must be. Just give me a few days to get my affairs in order."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "If Vina makes it back, tell her I'm sorry."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "And figure out what to say to Vina."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I thought that might be the case.""
entries.dialogueText: "I thought that might be the case."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I won't tell Vina we had this conversation."

entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I won't tell anyone else we had this conversation."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, you wouldn't execute the matriarch of the Sazon family without reason."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Who said I don't have a reason? She could be orchestrating another uprising from exile."

entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't. But we're at war. Bombs get dropped in all kinds of places. Like Caleqabiz."

entries.dialogueText: "She should have been executed before you were born. I'd just be handling my father's unfinished business. As usual."

entries.title: Narrator: "He sighed."
entries.dialogueText: He sighed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Relax. I was joking.""
entries.dialogueText: "Relax. I was joking."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Then what do you want, Your Majest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Then what do you want, Your Majesty? Just tell me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Tell her you met someone else."

entries.dialogueText: "Don't tell her a damn thing. Just go."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You'll come up with something, I'm sure."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I will."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I won't tell her a damn thing. That's part of the deal."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He shuddered audibly.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I wish there was another way...""
entries.dialogueText: "I wish there was another way..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Screw this. I'm not giving in to my uncle. Stay in Rizia, and I'll find a way to bring Angelica Sazon home."

entries.dialogueText: "Good. I'll need it."

entries.dialogueText: "I have... needs... that certain women in certain establishments in Iza and Porte Drazon are already well trained to fulfill."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, that was it."

entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Aside from the obligation to produ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Aside from the obligation to produce an heir, I expect the Princess and I would go about our lives much as we have been."

entries.dialogueText: "You have a lot of plans for the future of our kingdom, don't you? None of which seem to involve actual Rizians."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""As long as Rizia still belongs to..."
entries.dialogueText: "As long as Rizia still belongs to Rizians, we'll survive."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras

entries.dialogueText: "We won't let the other houses uproot this family tree."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Great.""
entries.dialogueText: "Great."
