entries.dialogueText: "I'm happy you see it that way as well."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I did not ask for that much inform..."
entries.dialogueText: "I did not ask for that much information."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, that's good to know. Thank y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, that's good to know. Thank you for your honesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't leave me hanging. What needs?""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't leave me hanging. What needs?"

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Thank you for the phone call, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the phone call, Your Majesty. Expect a prompt resolution of the Sazon situation."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I didn't want you to think I was l..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't want you to think I was lying."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Thank you for the phone call, Your..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the phone call, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We will grow straight and proud, u..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will grow straight and proud, until we reach the stars."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's not the other houses I'm worr..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not the other houses I'm worried about."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia su omina. Rizia above all.""
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia su omina. Rizia above all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It will. I promise you that.""
entries.dialogueText: "It will. I promise you that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "In the end, it's the Rizian bloodline that matters. Not any individual house."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That depends on your definition of..."
entries.dialogueText: "That depends on your definition of 'actual Rizians'."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do not talk back to your king. My..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not talk back to your king. My policies are not to be disputed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Giving foreigners more rights won'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Giving foreigners more rights won't endanger those of us who were born here."

entries.dialogueText: "No. Because we will fight to the death against being replaced."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Not by me alone. But there are others who feel this way."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Those of us with strong, deep, tie..."
entries.dialogueText: "Those of us with strong, deep, ties to  this land."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I think you'll find we will not be..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think you'll find we will not be so easily uprooted."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Now and always.""
entries.dialogueText: "Now and always."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Precisely.""
entries.dialogueText: "Precisely."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I -- we -- will hold you to it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I -- we -- will hold you to it."

entries.dialogueText: There was a click as he hung up.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He hung up."
entries.dialogueText: He hung up.

entries.dialogueText: "Goodnight, then."

entries.dialogueText: "You'd better not forget that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Serve well, and you will be reward..."
entries.dialogueText: "Serve well, and you will be rewarded for it."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I know."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras

entries.dialogueText: "No, no. Never."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Then accept my gratitude.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then accept my gratitude."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I won't.""
entries.dialogueText: "I won't."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Service to my family is its own re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Service to my family is its own reward."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Good night.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good night."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""I am nothing if not honest.""
entries.dialogueText: "I am nothing if not honest."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I asked you to frame Rico ages ago..."
entries.dialogueText: "I asked you to frame Rico ages ago. What the devil is going on?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Truly sorry, Your Majesty. We've been wrapped up in the war."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Truly sorry, Your Majesty. It hasn't been easy to find a way into his palace."

entries.dialogueText: "You and your cousin are both speaking at Iza University next month, are you not?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "I'll send a few extra guards ahead. They'll take care of it while the Duke is occupied at the event."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "They had damn well better. The clock is ticking."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Splendid. It's about time the kid..."
entries.dialogueText: "Splendid. It's about time the kid learned a lesson."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It gives me no great pleasure to t..."
entries.dialogueText: "It gives me no great pleasure to turn in my cousin. But for a reunited Rizia, it has to be done."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Remember how I asked you to plant..."
entries.dialogueText: "Remember how I asked you to plant evidence against my cousin? I changed my mind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus looked unfazed."
entries.dialogueText: Titus looked unfazed.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "I was going to tell my men to complete the task next month, while you're both speaking in Iza."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But I have not yet given the order..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I have not yet given the orders."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank God. The kid could be useful..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank God. The kid could be useful to me yet."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You should have taken care of this..."
entries.dialogueText: "You should have taken care of this months ago. But just as well. Call it off."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Well, if you've gone to all the tr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, if you've gone to all the trouble of planning it... I say do it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""He is your cousin. Perhaps it's be..."
entries.dialogueText: "He is your cousin. Perhaps it's best to keep him close."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Truly sorry. Our time has been lim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Truly sorry. Our time has been limited since the war started."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Truly sorry. It hasn't been easy t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Truly sorry. It hasn't been easy to find a way into his palace."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, I'm aware. The Golden Guard w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm aware. The Golden Guard will not fail you."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I have no doubt that jailing him w..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have no doubt that jailing him will be for the greater good."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Not every king would be so brave.""
entries.dialogueText: "Not every king would be so brave."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Should you choose to assign us a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Should you choose to assign us a similar task in the future, we will get to it straight away."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We will, Your Majesty. The Golden..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will, Your Majesty. The Golden Guard won't fail you."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus blinked."
entries.dialogueText: Titus blinked.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You'd like us to launch an investi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'd like us to launch an investigation into the young man?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No. I need him arrested. Preferabl..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. I need him arrested. Preferably tonight."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I haven't forgotten about our othe..."
entries.dialogueText: "I haven't forgotten about our other assignments. Rest assured we'll ferret out the truth soon."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need him out of the picture. Com..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need him out of the picture. Completely. I don't care how you do it."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I need you to do to him what you'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I need you to do to him what you're doing to Rico Toras. But faster."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Truly sorry, Your Majesty. We've b..."
entries.dialogueText: "Truly sorry, Your Majesty. We've been wrapped up in the war."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Truly sorry, Your Majesty. It hasn..."
entries.dialogueText: "Truly sorry, Your Majesty. It hasn't been easy to find a way into the Duke's palace."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""We were planning on completing the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We were planning on completing the task next month, while you're both speaking in Iza."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Given Mr. Sazon's lack of guards a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given Mr. Sazon's lack of guards and residence in Porte Drazon, targeting him with a similar operation would go much more swiftly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perfect. I want you to frame Manus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. I want you to frame Manus as a traitor to the throne. But don't forget about your original assignment."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Actually, never mind Manus. Keep y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Actually, never mind Manus. Keep your focus on Rico."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Do it, then. But don't bother fram..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do it, then. But don't bother framing Rico. The kid could still be of use to me."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Of course, Your Majesty. I'll tell..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Your Majesty. I'll tell my men to get right on it."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Noted. I'll tell my men to switch..."
entries.dialogueText: "Noted. I'll tell my men to switch their focus to the Sazon heir."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Noted.""
entries.dialogueText: "Noted."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He thought for a moment."
entries.dialogueText: He thought for a moment.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Given his family's history, nobody..."
entries.dialogueText: "Given his family's history, nobody would be surprised if evidence turned up connecting him to a plot against the throne."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A plot that requires him to earn t..."
entries.dialogueText: "A plot that requires him to earn the trust of the King's daughter."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Good thinking, Titus. What would I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good thinking, Titus. What would I do without you?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't know. Is it *too* obvious?""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know. Is it *too* obvious?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Interesting. Yes, we can include t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Interesting. Yes, we can include that detail."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You only need your council's appro..."
entries.dialogueText: "You only need your council's approval to jail him. And I doubt they'll ask many questions."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I am but an appendage of the Crown..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am but an appendage of the Crown. I'm sure you would manage."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Mr. Sazon lives in Porte Drazon wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Sazon lives in Porte Drazon without bodyguards. We can easily carry this out in the next few days."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""See you in Iza next month? I hear..."
entries.dialogueText: "See you in Iza next month? I hear we're both invited to speak at the university's anniversary."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm looking forward to it. As long as the students don't give us any trouble."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Don't remind me. I hate these kinds of engagements."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I expect the city to be in tip-top..."
entries.dialogueText: "I expect the city to be in tip-top shape for my arrival."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Oh, it will be. Believe me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, it will be. Believe me."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Really? I find the spotlight so in..."
entries.dialogueText: "Really? I find the spotlight so invigorating. Like a hot bath."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""That's not up to me, I'm afraid.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's not up to me, I'm afraid."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, I'm looking forward to it. Al..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I'm looking forward to it. All those bright young minds."

entries.speaker: Rico Toras
entries.title: Rico Toras: ""Bright, my foot. When I was their..."
entries.dialogueText: "Bright, my foot. When I was their age I was leading rallies, not idling about in a classroom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How are you?""
entries.dialogueText: "How are you?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm well, Your Majesty. I apologiz..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm well, Your Majesty. I apologize that the investigation into your father's death is taking such a long time."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm well, Your Majesty. I apologiz..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm well, Your Majesty. I apologize that our investigation into the Wehlen bombing is taking such a long time."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The war has been weighing on my mi..."
entries.dialogueText: "The war has been weighing on my mind, as I'm sure it has yours."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The fate of Zille has been weighin..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fate of Zille has been weighing on my mind, as I'm sure it has yours."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You have no idea.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have no idea."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fear not, Captain. The Lord will s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fear not, Captain. The Lord will show us the way."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I've hardly been thinking about it..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've hardly been thinking about it at all."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I wish all of Rizia shared your fa..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish all of Rizia shared your faith."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I understand. It's only one of man..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. It's only one of many problems you must attend to."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You bear an unimaginable amount of..."
entries.dialogueText: "You bear an unimaginable amount of responsibility. I do not envy you."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Tell Vina...""
entries.dialogueText: "Tell Vina..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Never mind. It's best for her to s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Never mind. It's best for her to stay out of this."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "You should be scared. If I don't act, we might both lose our heads."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, but now whatever affects you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but now whatever affects you affects Vina. Please be careful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't want to do as they're aski..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't want to do as they're asking. But my reign as king depends on it."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, I decided a long tim..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, I decided a long time ago that I would not live in fear. Whenever I die, that's my time."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This does not bode well for our re..."
entries.dialogueText: "This does not bode well for our reform plans. They'll be watching our every move."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We shouldn't give up, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "We shouldn't give up, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""It's not what Vina would want.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's not what Vina would want."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Pursuing a path of reform was alwa..."
entries.dialogueText: "Pursuing a path of reform was always going to lose you support from House Toras. But the Sazons are prepared to protect you from the fallout."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand. I will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand. I will."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But that time doesn't have to be r..."
entries.dialogueText: "But that time doesn't have to be right now."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""As it stands, House Sazon will not..."
entries.dialogueText: "As it stands, House Sazon will not protect you should you fall out of favor with your own family."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Maybe not.""
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe not."

entries.dialogueText: "It's been almost 30 years. Half her life."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Is that such a bad thing?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "A canny suggestion. House Sazon will be considerably stronger with its matriarch back on the mainland."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Stronger, and in great debt to you."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Obviously, it is your decision. But if you share my goal of bringing true democracy to Rizia, I see no other choice."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "No promises. But I'll see what I can do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your dedication to your mother is..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your dedication to your mother is touching. I'd do the same if it were mine."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "It's too high of a price to pay. She must carry out the sentence my father ordered her to serve."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Obviously, it is your decision. Bu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Obviously, it is your decision. But if you share my goal of bringing true democracy to Rizia, this will help us immensely."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""This is larger than just me. Bring..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is larger than just me. Bringing her back would bring hope to all of Brenas."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "I haven't forgotten about our other assignment. Rest assured we'll ferret out the truth soon."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "I'm well, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Was that all you wanted to ask me?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "And I guarantee it will get you the support you need from my house."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "If not, I guess I'll just have to kill you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I'm a king. I shouldn't have to wheedle for approval like a love-starved puppy."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Bruno nudged my foot with his nose.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Ha... ha?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "I should be going now. Thank you for your call."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Just wait till you and Vina get married. They won't be able to get enough of me."

entries.dialogueText: "If Her Highness is rescued, you mean..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "I've been planning to ask her for some time."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: We said our goodbyes and hung up.

entries.dialogueText: I picked up the phone.

entries.speaker: Rico Toras

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "One more thing."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Are you finally considering an expansion of the Golden Guard, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Titus immediately snapped to full attention.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "How confident do you feel in matters of national security?"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He straightened up even further.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Extremely confident, sir. My exper..."
entries.dialogueText: "Extremely confident, sir. My experience commanding the Golden Guard has primed me to adapt to new threats and formulate creative strategies."

entries.dialogueText: "Where do your loyalties lie, Titus? To me or to the Kingdom of Rizia?"

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He replied without hesitation.

entries.dialogueText: "I am charged with protecting the King and his family. No matter what other responsibilities I am granted, your personal security will always come first."

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: He straightened up even further.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I am happy to take on any role for..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am happy to take on any role for which you deem me suitable."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""If an opportunity for advancement..."
entries.dialogueText: "If an opportunity for advancement does arise and you are denied it. I hope you will not take it personally."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""That's very good to know.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's very good to know."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""No, Your Majesty. Of course not.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, Your Majesty. Of course not."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus nodded, somewhat bewildered."
entries.dialogueText: Titus nodded, somewhat bewildered.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's please move on from this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's please move on from this."

entries.dialogueText: "Believe me, I would love to. However..."

entries.dialogueText: "You have been less than subtle about your reform intentions."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Even going so far as to prohibit provincial leaders from shaping their own councils..."

entries.dialogueText: "To the point where the anti-monarchist radicals of the Rizian People's Party now hold a parliament majority!"

entries.dialogueText: He clutched at his brow.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "Romus, you must know that you cannot have it both ways. Valenqiris will only support your reforms if House Toras is assured some measure of continuity."

entries.dialogueText: "But the expanded Golden Guard could handle precisely this eventuality."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "But your allies in Su Omina could handle it. Just bring it up with your cousin."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will use neither carrot nor stic..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will use neither carrot nor stick. I maintain that the Sazon heir is a useful ally."

entries.dialogueText: Hugo replied without a trace of anger in his voice.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "Your Grace, I am intent on reforming the country precisely because we cannot go on as before."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""And they will get it. Our values a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And they will get it. Our values and traditions will not disappear simply because the commoners have more of a say in politics."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""These are cosmetic changes only, H..."
entries.dialogueText: "These are cosmetic changes only, Hugo. The status of the nobility will not be harmed."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your concern is duly noted. But I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your concern is duly noted. But I don't need Valenqiris' support."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I wish I could believe you. But lo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wish I could believe you. But look at what you've already done."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I don't think you've absorbed the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think you've absorbed the gravity of the situation."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras

entries.dialogueText: "You don't understand. Alienate House Toras and you, King Romus, will not go on at all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "I still have faith that we can change the country together, Mr. Sazon."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "As do I."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Perfect. I trust you to handle it..."
entries.dialogueText: "Perfect. I trust you to handle it at once."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "On second thought, don't. I need your full focus on Rico."

entries.dialogueText: "On second thought, don't. He may still be of use to me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: "No, no. If my daughter ever found out, she'd never look at me the same again."

entries.dialogueText: "We're on it, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion

entries.dialogueText: "Understood. We'll stay away from him."

entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't worry about it, Titus. You'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry about it, Titus. You're in charge of my security, not the nation's."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I know you petitioned my father fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you petitioned my father for the security councilor position. Why didn't you tell me?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My guard's breath caught in his thr..."
entries.dialogueText: My guard's breath caught in his throat.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I was... embarrassed to have even..."
entries.dialogueText: "I was... embarrassed to have even made the request, Your Majesty. Obviously, I was neither as qualified nor suited as the heiress of House Azaro."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""After the events of the past sever..."
entries.dialogueText: "After the events of the past several years, though, I would be proud to put my name forward."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Will that be all?""
entries.dialogueText: "Will that be all?"

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Can I ask you something? What happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can I ask you something? What happened to you back in Derdia?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Titus flinched."
entries.dialogueText: Titus flinched.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I must have been thrown off by the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must have been thrown off by the altitude. I'm sorry if my performance displeased you."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Don't let it happen again.""
entries.dialogueText: "Don't let it happen again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No worries. It happens to the best..."
entries.dialogueText: "No worries. It happens to the best of us."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I watched the fight. He barely tou..."
entries.dialogueText: "I watched the fight. He barely touched you. There's simply no way that blow was enough to make you collapse."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He lowered his eyes."
entries.dialogueText: He lowered his eyes.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, you're right.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, you're right."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It's an old boxing injury. Trauma..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's an old boxing injury. Trauma to the kidney that I never fully recovered from."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""It flares up sometimes, especially..."
entries.dialogueText: "It flares up sometimes, especially when there's an impact to the wrong area. Rest assured that I never let it get in the way of my duties."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I assure you, if we visit Derdia a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assure you, if we visit Derdia again, I will be better prepared for such an occasion."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't tolerate weakness in my gu..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't tolerate weakness in my guards, Titus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Was your injury the reason why you..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was your injury the reason why you left your post the night my father died?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I feel the same way. But I will ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "I feel the same way. But I will take precautions to protect myself from such incidents in the future."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Yes, I know. I hope you can forgiv..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, I know. I hope you can forgive me."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He stared at me with a mix of fear..."
entries.dialogueText: He stared at me with a mix of fear and shock.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I've learned to manage it over the..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've learned to manage it over the years."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'm sorry. That sounds painful.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry. That sounds painful."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Regardless, you should have told m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless, you should have told me about this liability of yours."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A shadow of disappointment crossed..."
entries.dialogueText: A shadow of disappointment crossed his face.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""What happens in the kingdom as a w..."
entries.dialogueText: "What happens in the kingdom as a whole greatly affects your personal security. I wouldn't be much of a guardsman if I didn't keep an ear to the ground."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Who told you that, Your Majesty?""
entries.dialogueText: "Who told you that, Your Majesty?"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He exhaled."
entries.dialogueText: He exhaled.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I... yes, Your Majesty. I was asha..."
entries.dialogueText: "I... yes, Your Majesty. I was ashamed to admit my vulnerability earlier."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Word gets around. Answer the quest..."
entries.dialogueText: "Word gets around. Answer the question."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Before she was arrested, Lucita co..."
entries.dialogueText: "Before she was arrested, Lucita considered you a suspect in my father's possible murder."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""God sees all. He told me.""
entries.dialogueText: "God sees all. He told me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It's possible my father was murder..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's possible my father was murdered. We're trying to get a full picture of what happened that night."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "His shoulders slumped."
entries.dialogueText: His shoulders slumped.

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""That's rubbish. Considering what w..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's rubbish. Considering what we now know about Duchess Azaro, I wouldn't trust a word of what she told you."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I... yes. One of my men re-activat..."
entries.dialogueText: "I... yes. One of my men re-activated the injury during a sparring session in the courtyard earlier in the day."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""The pain became too much to bear,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The pain became too much to bear, and I rushed to an unoccupied guest room to recuperate."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Do you have any other requests?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you have any other requests?"

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But yes, you are right. One of my..."
entries.dialogueText: "But yes, you are right. One of my men reactivated the injury during a sparring session in the courtyard earlier that day."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Then... He has spoken the truth.""
entries.dialogueText: "Then... He has spoken the truth."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""One of my men reactivated the inju..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of my men reactivated the injury during a sparring session in the courtyard earlier that day."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I assigned one of my men to my pos..."
entries.dialogueText: "I assigned one of my men to my post in my stead. When I returned, he reported no unusual activity."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""But I cannot help thinking I might..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I cannot help thinking I might have heard or noticed something he did not. At a moment when the King needed me most, I was not there."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I know now that I failed the King..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know now that I failed the King in his moment of need."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I will never let such a thing happ..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will never let such a thing happen to me again, Your Majesty. I swear upon my life."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Make it up to me. Find proof of Lu..."
entries.dialogueText: "Make it up to me. Find proof of Lucita's guilt."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It isn't your fault. Your replacem..."
entries.dialogueText: "It isn't your fault. Your replacement allowed Lucita into the room, but I don't believe she killed my father."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You had better not. I need to be a..."
entries.dialogueText: "You had better not. I need to be able to count on you. Titus."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You did everything right, Captain..."
entries.dialogueText: "You did everything right, Captain Gordion. Stop blaming yourself."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""All right. Thank you for telling m..."
entries.dialogueText: "All right. Thank you for telling me the truth."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I will. Give me time.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will. Give me time."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Don't underestimate what that woma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't underestimate what that woman was capable of. Look what happened at the Pales border."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I'm still focusing on our chosen s..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm still focusing on our chosen subject. But don't underestimate what Duchess Azaro is capable of."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""You can, sir. Now and always.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can, sir. Now and always."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""I will try.""
entries.dialogueText: "I will try."

entries.speaker: Titus Gordion
entries.title: Titus Gordion: ""Was there something else you wante..."
entries.dialogueText: "Was there something else you wanted from me?"

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""She speaks of her participation in..."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""But if she were to come to the mai..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if she were to come to the mainland and witness our movement -- if she were to see that reform is possible without bloodshed -- I am sure she'd be on our side."

entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. I'm not going to let Vina marry him."
